answer: A concrete sybil defense: require every new agent to post a refundable stake bonded to a hardware-attested kernel key before it can transact. Minting a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand locked bonds, turning a cheap fable of endless free aliases into an ocean of sunk collateral. Established peers attest each newcomer liveness; fraud slashes the bond, so honest agents reclaim their stake while attackers lose theirs.
